title: Pairwise Comparison for Bias Identification and Quantification

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating non-neutral lexical choices, framing, and presuppositions in news sentences (BABE dataset) by applying LLM-based pairwise and listwise comparisons, which are then aggregated using Elo and Bradley-Terry rating models to derive continuous bias severity scores and binary labels.

Quantifying negative sentiment and discriminatory stance towards minorities or demographic groups in social media posts (Us vs. Them dataset) using LLM-driven pairwise and listwise comparative rankings, comparing the derived ratings against crowd-sourced continuous annotations.
